title: Practice 2: Running, swimming, climbing, crawling, dragging

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: When the city had been captured, Aeneas fled.
exercises.why: **бежал** — past tense (masculine) of бежать: one-direction verb (many directions: бегать).

exercises.q: Salmon swim upstream to spawn.
exercises.why: **плывёт** — present tense (3rd person singular) of плыть: one-direction verb (many directions: плавать).
exercises.ru: Лосось ___ вверх по течению на нерест.

exercises.q: Our dogs, a poodle and a dachshund, are running around the yard.
exercises.why: **бегают** — present tense (3rd person plural) of бегать: many-directions verb (one direction: бежать).
exercises.ru: Наши собаки, пудель и такса, ___ по двору.

exercises.q: I jog before breakfast every morning.
exercises.why: **бегаю** — present tense (1st person singular) of бегать: many-directions verb (one direction: бежать).
exercises.ru: Я ___ трусцой перед завтраком каждое утро.

exercises.q: Can a two-year-old boy run that fast?
exercises.why: **бегать** — infinitive, many-directions verb (one direction: бежать).
exercises.ru: Может ли двухлетний мальчик ___ так быстро?

exercises.q: Белка ___ (лезть — to climb, one way; impf., pres. 3rd sg.) на дерево.
exercises.why: **лезет** — present tense (3rd person singular) of лезть: one-direction verb (many directions: лазить).
exercises.prompt: The squirrel is climbing the tree.

exercises.q: Они ___ (кататься — to roll (oneself); impf., past pl.) по траве.
exercises.why: **катались** — past tense (plural) of кататься: many-directions verb (one direction: катиться).
exercises.prompt: They rolled around in the grass.

exercises.q: Собака ___ (бежать — to run, one way; impf., past f. sg.) за зайцем.
exercises.why: **бежала** — past tense (feminine) of бежать: one-direction verb (many directions: бегать).
exercises.prompt: The dog ran after the rabbit.

exercises.q: ___ (бежать — to run, one way; impf., imper. sg.) и не оглядывайся.
exercises.why: **беги** — imperative (ты, singular) of бежать: one-direction verb (many directions: бегать).

exercises.q: Том ___ (кататься — to roll (oneself); impf., pres. 3rd sg.) на лыжах.
exercises.why: **катается** — present tense (3rd person singular) of кататься: many-directions verb (one direction: катиться).

exercises.q: ___ (бежать — to run, one way; impf., imper. sg.), иначе опоздаешь.
exercises.why: **беги** — imperative (ты, singular) of бежать: one-direction verb (many directions: бегать).
exercises.prompt: Run, or else you'll be late.

exercises.q: Не ___ (бежать — to run, one way; impf., imper. sg.). Иди спокойно.
exercises.why: **беги** — imperative (ты, singular) of бежать: one-direction verb (many directions: бегать).

exercises.q: Куда ___ (катиться — to roll (oneself); impf., pres. 3rd sg.) этот мир?
exercises.why: **катится** — present tense (3rd person singular) of катиться: one-direction verb (many directions: кататься).
exercises.prompt: What is this world coming to?

exercises.q: The wind wandered moaning round the house like a lost soul.
exercises.why: **бродил** — past tense (masculine) of бродить: many-directions verb (one direction: брести).
exercises.ru: Ветер ___ по дому, стеная, словно заблудшая душа.

exercises.q: Через поле ___ (бежать — to run, one way; impf., pres. 3rd sg.) лисица.
exercises.why: **бежит** — future tense (3rd person singular) of бежать: one-direction verb (many directions: бегать).
exercises.prompt: There's a fox running through the field.

exercises.q: Он ___ (кататься — to roll (oneself); impf., pres. 3rd sg.) на коньках.
exercises.why: **катается** — present tense (3rd person singular) of кататься: many-directions verb (one direction: катиться).

exercises.q: Таракан ___ (ползти — to crawl, one way; impf., pres. 3rd sg.) по стене.
exercises.why: **ползёт** — present tense (3rd person singular) of ползти: one-direction verb (many directions: ползать).
exercises.prompt: The cockroach is crawling along the wall.

exercises.q: Не ___ (лезть — to climb, one way; impf., imper. sg.) не в своё дело.
exercises.why: **лезь** — imperative (ты, singular) of лезть: one-direction verb (many directions: лазить).

exercises.q: Он ___ (тащить — to drag, one way; impf., pres. 3rd sg.) на спине сумку.
exercises.why: **тащит** — present tense (3rd person singular) of тащить: one-direction verb (many directions: таскать).
exercises.prompt: He carries a bag on his back.

exercises.q: Не ___ (лезть — to climb, one way; impf., imper. sg.) в неприятности.
exercises.why: **лезь** — imperative (ты, singular) of лезть: one-direction verb (many directions: лазить).
